name: m0-mcp-agent-prompt
description: docs/specs/vimma-mcp.md, sub-PR 2b: a real agent connection through the question line, on a real build. The window stays on main with a page focused while the agent works in the hidden agent workspace. A full connection is held before MCP is on (so its keys never ask); :mcp on and y; the agent's vimma_open asks in the line, y allows it, and main and its selected page are unchanged; a read with 15a grants 15 minutes and the next read runs unasked; then, MCP on, a new vimma-ctl asks for full control, y lets it in; :mcp off at the end, so the harness's own quit does not ask.

steps.keys: : m c p space o n enter
: m c p space o f f enter
